text: Studying period: The first week of November - December. (at least 4 weeks) Hours per week: 30 (45min/1class hour), 4 class hours in the morning and 2 class hours in the afternoon. Courses: Chinese reading and writing, Spoken Chinese Textbooks: 40 Lessons for Basic Chinese Course (the first volumn); Crash Spoken Chinese (beginner). Studying objective: After 8 weeks study, applicants can grasp the Chinese pronunciation and basic sentence patterns. With 1200 new words mastered, students can chat with Chinese people about daily topics. Tuition fees: The course will be opened at least 15 students. Those who want to join the class during the course will not be accepted. RMB 2500 for the first four weeks in total and RMB 500 will be added for each additional week.
